purpose: Criticize a contradiction between someone’s position and behavior.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
Plain clause / Nの / な-adjectiveな + くせして
You know, yet you refuse to tell me.
You were late too, so do not blame only me.
Despite being an adult, he took his frustration out on a child.
formation: Plain clause / Nの / な-adjectiveな + くせして
restrictions: Targets an inconsistency and can sound insulting.
mistake: Use のに for a neutral unexpected contrast.
